findings.summary: Overriding `__next__` on the runner's stdin wrapper to raise `EOFError` instead of `StopIteration` breaks all iteration over stdin (for loops, list(), click.File), causing commands to abort with exit code 1 after the last line.

The test dropped `assert not result.exception` and slices off the last two lines with `[:-2]`, assuming the run ends in "Aborted!"; it would pass even if the pipeline failed for another reason, hiding the new EOF abort instead of supplying enough input.
